record.question: What is the primary purpose of a CT-guided percutaneous drainage of an abscess?
options: To provide a definitive diagnosis of the abscess type.
To remove an infected fluid collection and facilitate healing.
To assess the size of the liver.
record.explanation: Answer C: To remove an infected fluid collection and facilitate healing.. Image-guided percutaneous drainage evacuates infected fluid and supports source control/healing. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/bodyct. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
